details: The package's preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime and uses it to execute a 727KB obfuscated script bundled as math_init.js. The script is obfuscated with a large encoded string array and a custom decoder, and contains eval/Function/child_process calls, so its full behavior is not statically readable. The package also depends on @or-sdk/base, which is a known-malicious package. Installing this package runs the obfuscated payload at install time.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
